svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version F: compact gallery and half the attic finished
svg.desc: Version F furnished preliminary diagram based on Version B. The open gallery is pulled in around the fixed stair: Bedroom 3, Closets 3 and 4 and Bedroom 4 move 5 feet 4 inches north, removing the old front band. Bath 4 sits directly above (north of) Bedroom 4 and Bath 3 sits beside it to the east, each about 8 feet 5 inches by 5 feet with a 32 by 60 inch shower, both entered from a 36-inch hall off the gallery; the fixed stair occupies the space above Bedroom 3. All four bedroom doors remain visible from one point in the gallery. The south half of the former attic over the north garage is finished: a laundry about 7 by 6.85 feet with side-by-side front-load washer and dryer under a counter, a provisional furnace closet about 3.5 by 3.65 feet, and an open flex loft of about 190 square feet that wraps behind Bath 3 with a two-desk homework nook. The north half stays unfinished attic storage, about 11.5 by 11.4 feet, entered from the flex loft and not counted. The primary suite keeps the full Version B width and bath with an 84 by 42 inch two-person shower; Closet 4 is 6 by 5 feet clear. Bedroom 2 is four inches shorter. Exterior-face gross area including walls and descending stairs, less the actual stair gap, is 1,984.0042 square feet. Floor framing over the garage span, roof and headroom, garage fire separation, furnace, combustion air, venting, plumbing and dryer venting require professional review.
svg.text: Version F: compact gallery + half the attic finished
PRELIMINARY DIAGRAM ONLY | 1,984.00 sq ft finished gross | 16.00 below 2,000 | + ~131 sq ft unfinished attic (not counted)
Rear / north at top; street / front at bottom. Plan geometry is to scale. Room sizes are approximate painted-face dimensions.
